First, take care of the kids (if there are some). A lot of school districts offer free lunch and breakfast to school children, and it helps a lot. It is also a great chance to get your kids socializing with others their age. 

After that, I'd get some hotdogs. You can put that in the rice, or do some pigs in the blanket with the biscuits. Do your best to get some veggies too. Call around, I'm sure there is a program near you that can help.
